title: J1939 CAN Transport Layer
text: Transport J1939 messages via CAN; {Config name} sets the j1939 network configuration name configuration list, {Device} sets the cAN device device, {Bus speed} sets the speed of CAN bus and {Sample time} sets the simulation refresh rate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Config name
params.values: J1939 network configuration name configuration list option
